pages.label: Geolocating
pages.title: Geolocate a video, scene by scene
pages.text: Mark each place a video shows as a scene. Geolocate it beside the map, drop leads, capture, and Make the proof lays out what it gathered.

pages.label: New post
pages.title: Geo Report is now Post
pages.text: A geolocation, a video thread, a map plate, a comparison or your own words, seen as X or Bluesky will show it, then marked as posted.

pages.label: Export
pages.title: Reports, written as they print
pages.text: No Markdown to learn: columns, charts, tables and sources as cards, out as a PDF, an offline page or your own site.

pages.label: Routines
pages.title: A routine over time
pages.text: Its dashboard reads every pass together, counts and spots that stay or come and go, and Catch up reads the passes it missed.

items.text: Collage plays a video in a rail under the canvas, and Panorama stitches the frames between A and B.
Inspect searches a part of a picture: draw a zone over it, then press Google Lens, Yandex, Bing or TinEye.
Horizon's Side by side is live: the photo above, the terrain under it, locked together or each on its own.
Align has its own seat on the map, and reading a shadow moved to Sun and moon.
Save place's arrow offers Save zone, and the case's places and media are two map layers of their own.
Tick Layers on the map to capture the map as drawn, each source credited on the picture.
A plate's map hides one feature, and its days play hour by hour when you ask.
Media's Unused filter finds the files nothing uses, and every delete says what it touches before it runs.
Settings › Website puts your notes online as a site of your own, on GitHub Pages.
Settings › General picks the accent colour of the interface among eleven.

pages.title: 3D is here
pages.text: Press 3D on the map and the imagery stands on its relief. Tilt, turn and fly down into any valley.

pages.label: Drawing tools
pages.title: Create your own map!
pages.text: Draw markers, lines and areas with your own icons, every change dated, then send it to My Maps or a KMZ.

pages.title: Maps ready to publish
pages.text: Start from a ready plate, set its look, and export an image, a PDF or a video of its days.

pages.label: View · Overlay · Find
pages.title: Horizon
pages.text: Stand on any point and see its skyline. Find ranks the places whose relief fits a photo's skyline.

pages.title: And also

items.text: Measure turns a line into range rings, a view cone or a line of sight.
Reference windows fade and play clips over the map.
Media opens in one full-screen viewer.

pages.help: The guide now shows every tool in pictures, and walks three tasks step by step.
